facts.text: Arizona College of Nursing offers a direct-entry, three-year Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) program that does not require prior college prerequisite coursework to enroll.

sources.title: How Does an Accelerated BSN Differ from a 3-Year BSN Program? | Arizona College of Nursing
sources.quote: Arizona College of Nursing offers a three-year BSN program with no prerequisite coursework required to start.
